import sys

def main():
    # Read the input string and strip any leading/trailing whitespace
    name = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    
    # Handle empty input
    if not name:
        print("")
        return
    
    # Split the name into parts
    parts = name.split()
    
    # Handle edge cases
    if len(parts) == 0:
        print("")
    elif len(parts) == 1:
        # Single name - just return it
        print(parts[0])
    elif len(parts) == 2:
        # Two names: "First Last" -> "Last, First"
        print(f"{parts[1]}, {parts[0]}")
    else:
        # Three or more names: "First Middle Last" -> "Last, First Middle"
        last = parts[-1]
        first_and_middle = " ".join(parts[:-1])
        print(f"{last}, {first_and_middle}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
